answer.reason: The verses give Philip a few distinct deeds beyond the summary: bringing Nathanael to Jesus, answering at the feeding of the multitude, and bringing the Greeks' request to Jesus.

clauses.english: found Nathanael and brought him to Jesus
clauses.quote: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him

clauses.english: told Jesus that two hundred pennyworth of bread was not enough for the great company
clauses.quote: Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them

clauses.english: told Andrew of the Greeks who wished to see Jesus, and they told Jesus
clauses.quote: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

doubts: Philip's request "show us the Father" (JHN 14:8-9) was left out as a saying rather than a deed.
Verses listing the Twelve and the upper room (MAT 10:3, MRK 3:18, LUK 6:14, ACT 1:13) only name him and were not used.
